title: High-Content CRISPR Screening: Methods and Applications.

title: Mitochondrial DNA mutations are associated with impaired oxidative phosphorylation and enhanced imatinib response in chronic myeloid leukemia.
snippet: Mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) mutations are frequently observed in cancer, but their clinical and functional significance in chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) remains incompletely defined. title: TRIM21 blocks DDX3X-driven stress granule formation during Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection via a non-canonical E3 ligase mechanism.
snippet: Tripartite motif-containing 21 (TRIM21) is an E3 ubiquitin ligase that binds viral and host proteins to mediate antiviral defense. Its role in Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) infection, however, is unclear.
